1.  The [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element children of the [media element](#173.html_media-element), in [tree order](#173.html_tree-order).
2.  Any [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) added using the [`addTextTrack()`](#173.html_dom-media-addtexttrack) method, in the order they were added, oldest first.
3.  Any [media-resource-specific text tracks](#173.html_media-resource-specific-text-track) ([text tracks](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to data in the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource)), in the order defined by the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource)'s format specification.

A [text track](#173.html_text-track) consists of:

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-kind" data-anolis-xref="text track kind">The kind of text track</dfn>

This decides how the track is handled by the user agent. The kind is represented by a string. The possible strings are:

*   <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-kind-subtitles">`subtitles`</dfn>
*   <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-captions" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-kind-captions">`captions`</dfn>
*   <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-kind-descriptions">`descriptions`</dfn>
*   <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-chapters" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-kind-chapters">`chapters`</dfn>
*   <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-metadata" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-kind-metadata">`metadata`</dfn>

The [kind of track](#173.html_text-track-kind) can change dynamically, in the case of a [text track](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-label" data-anolis-xref="text track label">A label</dfn>

This is a human-readable string intended to identify the track for the user.

The [label of a track](#173.html_text-track-label) can change dynamically, in the case of a [text track](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

When a [text track label](#173.html_text-track-label) is the empty string, the user agent should automatically generate an appropriate label from the text track's other properties (e.g. the kind of text track and the text track's language) for use in its user interface. This automatically-generated label is not exposed in the API.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type" data-anolis-xref="text track in-band metadata track dispatch type">An in-band metadata track dispatch type</dfn>

This is a string extracted from the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) specifically for in-band metadata tracks to enable such tracks to be dispatched to different scripts in the document.

For example, a traditional TV station broadcast streamed on the Web and augmented with Web-specific interactive features could include text tracks with metadata for ad targeting, trivia game data during game shows, player states during sports games, recipe information during food programs, and so forth. As each program starts and ends, new tracks might be added or removed from the stream, and as each one is added, the user agent could bind them to dedicated script modules using the value of this attribute.

Other than for in-band metadata text tracks, the [in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) is the empty string. How this value is populated for different media formats is described in [steps to expose a media-resource-specific text track](#173.html_steps-to-expose-a-media-resource-specific-text-track).

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-language" data-anolis-xref="text track language">A language</dfn>

This is a string (a BCP 47 language tag) representing the language of the text track's cues. [[BCP47]](#173.html_refsBCP47)

The [language of a text track](#173.html_text-track-language) can change dynamically, in the case of a [text track](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-readiness-state" data-anolis-xref="text track readiness state">A readiness state</dfn>

One of the following:

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-not-loaded" data-anolis-xref="text track not loaded">Not loaded</dfn>

Indicates that the text track's cues have not been obtained.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-loading" data-anolis-xref="text track loading">Loading</dfn>

Indicates that the text track is loading and there have been no fatal errors encountered so far. Further cues might still be added to the track by the parser.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-loaded" data-anolis-xref="text track loaded">Loaded</dfn>

Indicates that the text track has been loaded with no fatal errors.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-failed-to-load" data-anolis-xref="text track failed to load">Failed to load</dfn>

Indicates that the text track was enabled, but when the user agent attempted to obtain it, this failed in some way (e.g. URL could not be [resolved](#173.html_resolve-a-url), network error, unknown text track format). Some or all of the cues are likely missing and will not be obtained.

The [readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) of a [text track](#173.html_text-track) changes dynamically as the track is obtained.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-mode" data-anolis-xref="text track mode">A mode</dfn>

One of the following:

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-disabled" data-anolis-xref="text track disabled">Disabled</dfn>

Indicates that the text track is not active. Other than for the purposes of exposing the track in the DOM, the user agent is ignoring the text track. No cues are active, no events are fired, and the user agent will not attempt to obtain the track's cues.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-hidden" data-anolis-xref="text track hidden">Hidden</dfn>

Indicates that the text track is active, but that the user agent is not actively displaying the cues. If no attempt has yet been made to obtain the track's cues, the user agent will perform such an attempt momentarily. The user agent is maintaining a list of which cues are active, and events are being fired accordingly.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-showing" data-anolis-xref="text track showing">Showing</dfn>

Indicates that the text track is active. If no attempt has yet been made to obtain the track's cues, the user agent will perform such an attempt momentarily. The user agent is maintaining a list of which cues are active, and events are being fired accordingly. In addition, for text tracks whose [kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is [`subtitles`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles) or [`captions`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-captions), the cues are being overlaid on the video as appropriate; for text tracks whose [kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is [`descriptions`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions), the user agent is making the cues available to the user in a non-visual fashion; and for text tracks whose [kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is [`chapters`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-chapters), the user agent is making available to the user a mechanism by which the user can navigate to any point in the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) by selecting a cue.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-list-of-cues" data-anolis-xref="text track list of cues">A list of zero or more cues</dfn>

A list of [text track cues](#173.html_text-track-cue), along with <dfn id="173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering">rules for updating the text track rendering</dfn>. For example, for [WebVTT](#173.html_webvtt), the [rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks). [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

The [list of cues of a text track](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) can change dynamically, either because the [text track](#173.html_text-track) has [not yet been loaded](#173.html_text-track-not-loaded) or is still [loading](#173.html_text-track-loading), or due to DOM manipulation.

Each [text track](#173.html_text-track) has a corresponding [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object.

* * *

Each [media element](#173.html_media-element) has a <dfn id="173.html_list-of-pending-text-tracks">list of pending text tracks</dfn>, which must initially be empty, a <dfn id="173.html_blocked-on-parser">blocked-on-parser</dfn> flag, which must initially be false, and a <dfn id="173.html_did-perform-automatic-track-selection">did-perform-automatic-track-selection</dfn> flag, which must also initially be false.

When the user agent is required to <dfn id="173.html_populate-the-list-of-pending-text-tracks">populate the list of pending text tracks</dfn> of a [media element](#173.html_media-element), the user agent must add to the element's [list of pending text tracks](#173.html_list-of-pending-text-tracks) each [text track](#173.html_text-track) in the element's [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks) whose [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is not [disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled) and whose [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) is [loading](#173.html_text-track-loading).

Whenever a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's parent node changes, the user agent must remove the corresponding [text track](#173.html_text-track) from any [list of pending text tracks](#173.html_list-of-pending-text-tracks) that it is in.

Whenever a [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) changes to either [loaded](#173.html_text-track-loaded) or [failed to load](#173.html_text-track-failed-to-load), the user agent must remove it from any [list of pending text tracks](#173.html_list-of-pending-text-tracks) that it is in.

When a [media element](#173.html_media-element) is created by an [HTML parser](#173.html_html-parser) or [XML parser](#173.html_xml-parser), the user agent must set the element's [blocked-on-parser](#173.html_blocked-on-parser) flag to true. When a [media element](#173.html_media-element) is popped off the [stack of open elements](#173.html_stack-of-open-elements) of an [HTML parser](#173.html_html-parser) or [XML parser](#173.html_xml-parser), the user agent must [honor user preferences for automatic text track selection](#173.html_honor-user-preferences-for-automatic-text-track-selection), [populate the list of pending text tracks](#173.html_populate-the-list-of-pending-text-tracks), and set the element's [blocked-on-parser](#173.html_blocked-on-parser) flag to false.

The [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) of a [media element](#173.html_media-element) are <dfn id="173.html_the-text-tracks-are-ready" data-anolis-xref="the text tracks are ready">ready</dfn> when both the element's [list of pending text tracks](#173.html_list-of-pending-text-tracks) is empty and the element's [blocked-on-parser](#173.html_blocked-on-parser) flag is false.

Each [media element](#173.html_media-element) has a <dfn id="173.html_pending-text-track-change-notification-flag">pending text track change notification flag</dfn>, which must initially be unset.

Whenever a [text track](#173.html_text-track) that is in a [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks) has its [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) change value, the user agent must run the following steps for the [media element](#173.html_media-element):

1.  If the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [pending text track change notification flag](#173.html_pending-text-track-change-notification-flag) is set, abort these steps.

2.  Set the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [pending text track change notification flag](#173.html_pending-text-track-change-notification-flag).

3.  [Queue a task](#173.html_queue-a-task) that runs the following substeps:

    1.  Unset the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [pending text track change notification flag](#173.html_pending-text-track-change-notification-flag).

    2.  [Fire a simple event](#173.html_fire-a-simple-event) named [`change`](#173.html_event-media-change) at the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) attribute's [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

4.  If the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [show poster flag](#173.html_show-poster-flag) is not set, run the *[time marches on](#173.html_time-marches-on)* steps.

The [task source](#173.html_task-source) for the [tasks](#173.html_concept-task) listed in this section is the [DOM manipulation task source](#173.html_dom-manipulation-task-source).

* * *

A <dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue">text track cue</dfn> is the unit of time-sensitive data in a [text track](#173.html_text-track), corresponding for instance for subtitles and captions to the text that appears at a particular time and disappears at another time.

Each [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) consists of:

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-identifier" data-anolis-xref="text track cue identifier">An identifier</dfn>

An arbitrary string.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-start-time" data-anolis-xref="text track cue start time">A start time</dfn>

The time, in seconds and fractions of a second, that describes the beginning of the range of the [media data](#173.html_media-data) to which the cue applies.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-end-time" data-anolis-xref="text track cue end time">An end time</dfn>

The time, in seconds and fractions of a second, that describes the end of the range of the [media data](#173.html_media-data) to which the cue applies.

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag" data-anolis-xref="text track cue pause-on-exit flag">A pause-on-exit flag</dfn>

A boolean indicating whether playback of the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is to pause when the end of the range to which the cue applies is reached.

Some additional format-specific data

Additional fields, as needed for the format. For example, WebVTT has a [text track cue writing direction](#173.html_text-track-cue-writing-direction) and so forth. [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

<dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-data" data-anolis-xref="text track cue data">The data of the cue</dfn>

The raw data of the cue, and <dfn id="173.html_rules-for-rendering-the-cue-in-isolation">rules for rendering the cue in isolation</dfn>.

The precise nature of this data is defined by the format. For example, WebVTT uses text.

The [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time) and [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) can be negative. (The [current playback position](#173.html_current-playback-position) can never be negative, though, so cues entirely before time zero cannot be active.)

Each [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) has a corresponding [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object (or more specifically, an object that inherits from [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) — for example, WebVTT cues use the `VTTCue` interface). A [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue)'s in-memory representation can be dynamically changed through this [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) API. [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

A [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) is associated with [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering), as defined by the specification for the specific kind of [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue). These rules are used specifically when the object representing the cue is added to a [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object using the [`addCue()`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-addcue) method.

In addition, each [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) has two pieces of dynamic information:

The <dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-active-flag" data-anolis-xref="text track cue active flag">active flag</dfn>

This flag must be initially unset. The flag is used to ensure events are fired appropriately when the cue becomes active or inactive, and to make sure the right cues are rendered.

The user agent must synchronously unset this flag whenever the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) is removed from its [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues); whenever the [text track](#173.html_text-track) itself is removed from its [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks) or has its [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) changed to [disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled); and whenever the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`readyState`](#173.html_dom-media-readystate) is changed back to [`HAVE_NOTHING`](#173.html_dom-media-have_nothing). When the flag is unset in this way for one or more cues in [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) that were [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing) prior to the relevant incident, the user agent must, after having unset the flag for all the affected cues, apply the [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) of those [text tracks](#173.html_text-track). For example, for [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) based on [WebVTT](#173.html_webvtt), the [rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks). [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

The <dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-display-state" data-anolis-xref="text track cue display state">display state</dfn>

This is used as part of the rendering model, to keep cues in a consistent position. It must initially be empty. Whenever the [text track cue active flag](#173.html_text-track-cue-active-flag) is unset, the user agent must empty the [text track cue display state](#173.html_text-track-cue-display-state).

The [text track cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) of a [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) are ordered relative to each other in the <dfn id="173.html_text-track-cue-order">text track cue order</dfn>, which is determined as follows: first group the [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) by their [text track](#173.html_text-track), with the groups being sorted in the same order as their [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) appear in the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks); then, within each group, [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) must be sorted by their [start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time), earliest first; then, any [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) with the same [start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time) must be sorted by their [end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time), latest first; and finally, any [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) with identical [end times](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) must be sorted in the order they were last added to their respective [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues), oldest first (so e.g. for cues from a [WebVTT](#173.html_webvtt) file, that would initially be the order in which the cues were listed in the file). [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

###### 4.7.10.12.2 Sourcing in-band text tracks

A <dfn id="173.html_media-resource-specific-text-track">media-resource-specific text track</dfn> is a [text track](#173.html_text-track) that corresponds to data found in the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource).

Rules for processing and rendering such data are defined by the relevant specifications, e.g. the specification of the video format if the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is a video.

When a [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) contains data that the user agent recognises and supports as being equivalent to a [text track](#173.html_text-track), the user agent [runs](#173.html_found-a-media-resource-specific-timed-track) the <dfn id="173.html_steps-to-expose-a-media-resource-specific-text-track">steps to expose a media-resource-specific text track</dfn> with the relevant data, as follows.

1.  Associate the relevant data with a new [text track](#173.html_text-track) and its corresponding new [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object. The [text track](#173.html_text-track) is a [media-resource-specific text track](#173.html_media-resource-specific-text-track).

2.  Set the new [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [kind](#173.html_text-track-kind), [label](#173.html_text-track-label), and [language](#173.html_text-track-language) based on the semantics of the relevant data, as defined for the relevant format [[INBANDTRACKS]](#173.html_refsINBANDTRACKS). If there is no label in that data, then the [label](#173.html_text-track-label) must be set to the empty string.

3.  Associate the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) with the [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) appropriate for the format in question.

4.  If the new [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is [`metadata`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-metadata), then set the [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) as follows, based on the type of the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource):

    If the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is an Ogg file

    The [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the value of the Role header field. [[OGGSKELETONHEADERS]](#173.html_refsOGGSKELETONHEADERS)

    If the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is a WebM file

    The [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the value of the `CodecID` element. [[WEBMCG]](#173.html_refsWEBMCG)

    If the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is an MPEG-2 file

    Let `stream type` be the value of the "stream_type" field describing the text track's type in the file's program map section, interpreted as an 8-bit unsigned integer. Let `length` be the value of the "ES_info_length" field for the track in the same part of the program map section, interpreted as an integer as defined by the MPEG-2 specification. Let `descriptor bytes` be the `length` bytes following the "ES_info_length" field. The [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the concatenation of the `stream type` byte and the zero or more `descriptor bytes` bytes, expressed in hexadecimal using [uppercase ASCII hex digits](#173.html_uppercase-ascii-hex-digits). [[MPEG2]](#173.html_refsMPEG2)

    If the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is an MPEG-4 file

    Let the first `stsd` box of the first `stbl` box of the first `minf` box of the first `mdia` box of the [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s `trak` box in the first `moov` box of the file be the *stsd box*, if any. If the file has no *stsd box*, or if the *stsd box* has neither a `mett` box nor a `metx` box, then the [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the empty string. Otherwise, if the *stsd box* has a `mett` box then the [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the concatenation of the string "`mett`", a U+0020 SPACE character, and the value of the first `mime_format` field of the first `mett` box of the *stsd box*, or the empty string if that field is absent in that box. Otherwise, if the *stsd box* has no `mett` box but has a `metx` box then the [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the concatenation of the string "`metx`", a U+0020 SPACE character, and the value of the first `namespace` field of the first `metx` box of the *stsd box*, or the empty string if that field is absent in that box. [[MPEG4]](#173.html_refsMPEG4)

    If the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is a DASH media resource

    The [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the concatenation of the "AdaptationSet" element attributes and all child Role descriptors. [[DASH]](#173.html_refsDASH)

5.  Populate the new [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) with the cues parsed so far, following the [guidelines for exposing cues](#173.html_guidelines-for-exposing-cues-in-various-formats-as-text-track-cues), and begin updating it dynamically as necessary.

6.  Set the new [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) to [loaded](#173.html_text-track-loaded).

7.  Set the new [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) to the mode consistent with the user's preferences and the requirements of the relevant specification for the data.

8.  Add the new [text track](#173.html_text-track) to the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks).

9.  [Fire](#173.html_concept-event-fire) a [trusted](#173.html_concept-events-trusted) event with the name [`addtrack`](#173.html_event-media-addtrack), that does not bubble and is not cancelable, and that uses the [`TrackEvent`](#173.html_trackevent) interface, with the [`track`](#173.html_dom-trackevent-track) attribute initialized to the [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object, at the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) attribute's [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

###### 4.7.10.12.3 Sourcing out-of-band text tracks

When a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element is created, it must be associated with a new [text track](#173.html_text-track) (with its value set as defined below) and its corresponding new [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object.

The [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is determined from the state of the element's [`kind`](#173.html_attr-track-kind) attribute according to the following table; for a state given in a cell of the first column, the [kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is the string given in the second column:

| State | String |
| --- | --- |
| [Subtitles](#173.html_attr-track-kind-subtitles) | [`subtitles`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles) |
| [Captions](#173.html_attr-track-kind-captions) | [`captions`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-captions) |
| [Descriptions](#173.html_attr-track-kind-descriptions) | [`descriptions`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions) |
| [Chapters](#173.html_attr-track-kind-chapters) | [`chapters`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-chapters) |
| [Metadata](#173.html_attr-track-kind-metadata) | [`metadata`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-metadata) |

The [text track label](#173.html_text-track-label) is the element's [track label](#173.html_track-label).

The [text track language](#173.html_text-track-language) is the element's [track language](#173.html_track-language), if any, or the empty string otherwise.

As the [`kind`](#173.html_attr-track-kind), [`label`](#173.html_attr-track-label), and [`srclang`](#173.html_attr-track-srclang) attributes are set, changed, or removed, the [text track](#173.html_text-track) must update accordingly, as per the definitions above.

Changes to the [track URL](#173.html_track-url) are handled in the algorithm below.

The [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) is initially [not loaded](#173.html_text-track-not-loaded), and the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is initially [disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled).

The [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) is initially empty. It is dynamically modified when the referenced file is parsed. Associated with the list are the [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) appropriate for the format in question; for [WebVTT](#173.html_webvtt), this is the [rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks). [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

When a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's parent element changes and the new parent is a [media element](#173.html_media-element), then the user agent must add the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's corresponding [text track](#173.html_text-track) to the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks), and then [queue a task](#173.html_queue-a-task) to [fire](#173.html_concept-event-fire) a [trusted](#173.html_concept-events-trusted) event with the name [`addtrack`](#173.html_event-media-addtrack), that does not bubble and is not cancelable, and that uses the [`TrackEvent`](#173.html_trackevent) interface, with the [`track`](#173.html_dom-trackevent-track) attribute initialized to the [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object, at the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) attribute's [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

When a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's parent element changes and the old parent was a [media element](#173.html_media-element), then the user agent must remove the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's corresponding [text track](#173.html_text-track) from the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks), and then [queue a task](#173.html_queue-a-task) to [fire](#173.html_concept-event-fire) a [trusted](#173.html_concept-events-trusted) event with the name [`removetrack`](#173.html_event-media-removetrack), that does not bubble and is not cancelable, and that uses the [`TrackEvent`](#173.html_trackevent) interface, with the [`track`](#173.html_dom-trackevent-track) attribute initialized to the [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object, at the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) attribute's [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

* * *

When a [text track](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element is added to a [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks), the user agent must [queue a task](#173.html_queue-a-task) to run the following steps for the [media element](#173.html_media-element):

1.  If the element's [blocked-on-parser](#173.html_blocked-on-parser) flag is true, abort these steps.

2.  If the element's [did-perform-automatic-track-selection](#173.html_did-perform-automatic-track-selection) flag is true, abort these steps.

3.  [Honor user preferences for automatic text track selection](#173.html_honor-user-preferences-for-automatic-text-track-selection) for this element.

When the user agent is required to <dfn id="173.html_honor-user-preferences-for-automatic-text-track-selection">honor user preferences for automatic text track selection</dfn> for a [media element](#173.html_media-element), the user agent must run the following steps:

1.  [Perform automatic text track selection](#173.html_perform-automatic-text-track-selection) for [`subtitles`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles) and [`captions`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-captions).

2.  [Perform automatic text track selection](#173.html_perform-automatic-text-track-selection) for [`descriptions`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions).

3.  [Perform automatic text track selection](#173.html_perform-automatic-text-track-selection) for [`chapters`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-chapters).

4.  If there are any [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks) whose [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is [`metadata`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind-metadata) that correspond to [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) elements with a [`default`](#173.html_attr-track-default) attribute set whose [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is set to [disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled), then set the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of all such tracks to [hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden)

5.  Set the element's [did-perform-automatic-track-selection](#173.html_did-perform-automatic-track-selection) flag to true.

When the steps above say to <dfn id="173.html_perform-automatic-text-track-selection">perform automatic text track selection</dfn> for one or more [text track kinds](#173.html_text-track-kind), it means to run the following steps:

1.  Let `candidates` be a list consisting of the [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks) whose [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) is one of the kinds that were passed to the algorithm, if any, in the order given in the [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks).

2.  If `candidates` is empty, then abort these steps.

3.  If any of the [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in `candidates` have a [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) set to [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing), abort these steps.

4.  If the user has expressed an interest in having a track from `candidates` enabled based on its [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind), [text track language](#173.html_text-track-language), and [text track label](#173.html_text-track-label), then set its [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) to [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing).

    For example, the user could have set a browser preference to the effect of "I want French captions whenever possible", or "If there is a subtitle track with 'Commentary' in the title, enable it", or "If there are audio description tracks available, enable one, ideally in Swiss German, but failing that in Standard Swiss German or Standard German".

    Otherwise, if there are any [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in `candidates` that correspond to [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) elements with a [`default`](#173.html_attr-track-default) attribute set whose [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is set to [disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled), then set the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the first such track to [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing).

When a [text track](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element experiences any of the following circumstances, the user agent must [start the `track` processing model](#173.html_start-the-track-processing-model) for that [text track](#173.html_text-track) and its [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element:

*   The [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element is created.
*   The [text track](#173.html_text-track) has its [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) changed.
*   The [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's parent element changes and the new parent is a [media element](#173.html_media-element).

When a user agent is to <dfn id="173.html_start-the-track-processing-model">start the `track` processing model</dfn> for a [text track](#173.html_text-track) and its [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element, it must run the following algorithm. This algorithm interacts closely with the [event loop](#173.html_event-loop) mechanism; in particular, it has a [synchronous section](#173.html_synchronous-section) (which is triggered as part of the [event loop](#173.html_event-loop) algorithm). The steps in that section are marked with ?.

1.  If another occurrence of this algorithm is already running for this [text track](#173.html_text-track) and its [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element, abort these steps, letting that other algorithm take care of this element.

2.  If the [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is not set to one of [hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) or [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing), abort these steps.

3.  If the [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element does not have a [media element](#173.html_media-element) as a parent, abort these steps.

4.  Run the remainder of these steps asynchronously, allowing whatever caused these steps to run to continue.

5.  *Top*: [Await a stable state](#173.html_await-a-stable-state). The [synchronous section](#173.html_synchronous-section) consists of the following steps. (The steps in the [synchronous section](#173.html_synchronous-section) are marked with ?.)

6.  ? Set the [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) to [loading](#173.html_text-track-loading).

7.  ? Let `URL` be the [track URL](#173.html_track-url) of the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

8.  ? If the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's parent is a [media element](#173.html_media-element) then let `CORS mode` be the state of the parent [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`crossorigin`](#173.html_attr-media-crossorigin) content attribute. Otherwise, let `CORS mode` be [No CORS](#173.html_attr-crossorigin-none).

9.  End the [synchronous section](#173.html_synchronous-section), continuing the remaining steps asynchronously.

10.  If `URL` is not the empty string, perform a [potentially CORS-enabled fetch](#173.html_potentially-cors-enabled-fetch) of `URL`, with the *mode* being `CORS mode`, the *origin* being the [origin](#173.html_origin-0) of the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's [`Document`](#173.html_document), and the *default origin behaviour* set to *fail*.

    The resource obtained in this fashion, if any, contains the text track data. If any data is obtained, it is by definition [CORS-same-origin](#173.html_cors-same-origin) (cross-origin resources that are not suitably CORS-enabled do not get this far).

    The [tasks](#173.html_concept-task) [queued](#173.html_queue-a-task) by the [fetching algorithm](#173.html_fetch) on the [networking task source](#173.html_networking-task-source) to process the data as it is being fetched must determine the type of the resource. If the type of the resource is not a supported text track format, the load will fail, as described below. Otherwise, the resource's data must be passed to the appropriate parser (e.g. the [WebVTT parser](#173.html_webvtt-parser)) as it is received, with the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) being used for that parser's output. [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

    The appropriate parser will synchronously (during these [networking task source](#173.html_networking-task-source) [tasks](#173.html_concept-task)) and incrementally (as each such task is run with whatever data has been received from the network) update the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues).

    This specification does not currently say whether or how to check the MIME types of text tracks, or whether or how to perform file type sniffing using the actual file data. Implementors differ in their intentions on this matter and it is therefore unclear what the right solution is. In the absence of any requirement here, the HTTP specification's strict requirement to follow the Content-Type header prevails ("Content-Type specifies the media type of the underlying data." ... "If and only if the media type is not given by a Content-Type field, the recipient MAY attempt to guess the media type via inspection of its content and/or the name extension(s) of the URI used to identify the resource.").

    If the [fetching algorithm](#173.html_fetch) fails for any reason (network error, the server returns an error code, a cross-origin check fails, etc), if `URL` is the empty string, or if the type of the resource is not a supported text track format, then run these steps:

    1.  [Queue a task](#173.html_queue-a-task) to first change the [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) to [failed to load](#173.html_text-track-failed-to-load) and then [fire a simple event](#173.html_fire-a-simple-event) named `error` at the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

    2.  Wait until the [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) is no longer set to [loading](#173.html_text-track-loading).

    3.  Wait until the [track URL](#173.html_track-url) is no longer equal to `URL`, at the same time as the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is set to [hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) or [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing).

    4.  Jump to the step labeled *top*.

    If the [fetching algorithm](#173.html_fetch) does not fail, then the final [task](#173.html_concept-task) that is [queued](#173.html_queue-a-task) by the [networking task source](#173.html_networking-task-source) must run the following steps after it has tried to parse the data:

    1.  Change the [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) to [loaded](#173.html_text-track-loaded).

    2.  If the file was successfully processed, [fire a simple event](#173.html_fire-a-simple-event) named `load` at the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

        Otherwise, the file was not successfully processed (e.g. the format in question is an XML format and the file contained a well-formedness error that the XML specification requires be detected and reported to the application); [fire a simple event](#173.html_fire-a-simple-event) named `error` at the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

    3.  Wait until the [track URL](#173.html_track-url) is no longer equal to `URL`, at the same time as the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is set to [hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) or [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing).

    4.  Jump back to the step labeled *top*.

    If, while the [fetching algorithm](#173.html_fetch) is active, either:

    *   the [track URL](#173.html_track-url) changes so that it is no longer equal to `URL`, while the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) is set to [hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) or [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing); or
    *   the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) changes to [hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) or [showing](#173.html_text-track-showing), while the [track URL](#173.html_track-url) is not equal to `URL`

    ...then the user agent must run the following steps:

    1.  Abort the [fetching algorithm](#173.html_fetch), discarding any pending [tasks](#173.html_concept-task) generated by that algorithm (and in particular, not adding any cues to the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) after the moment the URL changed).

    2.  Jump back to the step labeled *top*.

    Until one of the above circumstances occurs, the user agent must remain on this step.

Whenever a [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element has its [`src`](#173.html_attr-track-src) attribute set, changed, or removed, the user agent must synchronously empty the element's [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues). (This also causes the algorithm above to stop adding cues from the resource being obtained using the previously given URL, if any.)

###### 4.7.10.12.4 <dfn>Guidelines for exposing cues</dfn> in various formats as [text track cues](#173.html_text-track-cue)

How a specific format's text track cues are to be interpreted for the purposes of processing by an HTML user agent is defined by that format [[INBANDTRACKS]](#173.html_refsINBANDTRACKS). In the absence of such a specification, this section provides some constraints within which implementations can attempt to consistently expose such formats.

To support the [text track](#173.html_text-track) model of HTML, each unit of timed data is converted to a [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue). Where the mapping of the format's features to the aspects of a [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) as defined in this specification are not defined, implementations must ensure that the mapping is consistent with the definitions of the aspects of a [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) as defined above, as well as with the following constraints:

The [text track cue identifier](#173.html_text-track-cue-identifier)

Should be set to the empty string if the format has no obvious analogue to a per-cue identifier.

The [text track cue pause-on-exit flag](#173.html_text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag)

Should be set to false.

###### 4.7.10.12.5 Text track API

```
interface TextTrackList : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter TextTrack (unsigned long index);
  TextTrack? getTrackById(DOMString id);

           attribute EventHandler onchange;
           attribute EventHandler onaddtrack;
           attribute EventHandler onremovetrack;
};
```

`media` . [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) . `length`

Returns the number of [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) associated with the [media element](#173.html_media-element) (e.g. from [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) elements). This is the number of [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks).

`media` . [`textTracks[`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) `n` `]`

Returns the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object representing the `n`th [text track](#173.html_text-track) in the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks).

`textTrack` = `media` . [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) . [`getTrackById`](#173.html_dom-texttracklist-gettrackbyid)( `id` )

Returns the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object with the given identifier, or null if no track has that identifier.

`track` . [`track`](#173.html_dom-track-track)

Returns the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object representing the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element's [text track](#173.html_text-track).

A [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object represents a dynamically updating list of [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in a given order.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-media-texttracks" data-anolis-xref="dom-media-textTracks">`textTracks`</dfn> attribute of [media elements](#173.html_media-element) must return a [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object representing the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) objects of the [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks), in the same order as in the [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks). The same object must be returned each time the attribute is accessed. [[WEBIDL]](#173.html_refsWEBIDL)

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttracklist-length" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackList-length">`length`</dfn> attribute of a [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object must return the number of [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

The [supported property indices](#173.html_supported-property-indices) of a [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object at any instant are the numbers from zero to the number of [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object minus one, if any. If there are no [text tracks](#173.html_text-track) in the list, there are no [supported property indices](#173.html_supported-property-indices).

To [determine the value of an indexed property](#173.html_determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property) of a [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object for a given index `index`, the user agent must return the `index`th [text track](#173.html_text-track) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttracklist-gettrackbyid" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackList-getTrackById">`getTrackById(``id``)`</dfn> method must return the first [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) in the [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object whose [`id`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-id) IDL attribute would return a value equal to the value of the `id` argument. When no tracks match the given argument, the method must return null.

* * *

```
enum TextTrackMode { "disabled",  "hidden",  "showing" };
enum TextTrackKind { "subtitles",  "captions",  "descriptions",  "chapters",  "metadata" };
interface TextTrack : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute TextTrackKind kind;
  readonly attribute DOMString label;
  readonly attribute DOMString language;

  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute DOMString inBandMetadataTrackDispatchType;

           attribute TextTrackMode mode;

  readonly attribute TextTrackCueList? cues;
  readonly attribute TextTrackCueList? activeCues;

  void addCue(TextTrackCue cue);
  void removeCue(TextTrackCue cue);

           attribute EventHandler oncuechange;
};
```

`textTrack` = `media` . [`addTextTrack`](#173.html_dom-media-addtexttrack)( `kind` [, `label` [, `language` ] ] )

Creates and returns a new [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object, which is also added to the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks).

`textTrack` . [`kind`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-kind)

Returns the [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) string.

`textTrack` . [`label`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-label)

Returns the [text track label](#173.html_text-track-label), if there is one, or the empty string otherwise (indicating that a custom label probably needs to be generated from the other attributes of the object if the object is exposed to the user).

`textTrack` . [`language`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-language)

Returns the [text track language](#173.html_text-track-language) string.

`textTrack` . [`id`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-id)

Returns the ID of the given track.

For in-band tracks, this is the ID that can be used with a fragment identifier if the format supports the Media Fragments URI syntax, and that can be used with the [`getTrackById()`](#173.html_dom-texttracklist-gettrackbyid) method. [[MEDIAFRAG]](#173.html_refsMEDIAFRAG)

For [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) objects corresponding to [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) elements, this is the ID of the [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) element.

`textTrack` . [`inBandMetadataTrackDispatchType`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-inbandmetadatatrackdispatchtype)

Returns the [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) string.

`textTrack` . [`mode`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-mode) [ = `value` ]

Returns the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode), represented by a string from the following list:

"[`disabled`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-disabled)"

The [text track disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled) mode.

"[`hidden`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-hidden)"

The [text track hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) mode.

"[`showing`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-showing)"

The [text track showing](#173.html_text-track-showing) mode.

Can be set, to change the mode.

`textTrack` . [`cues`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-cues)

Returns the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues), as a [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object.

`textTrack` . [`activeCues`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-activecues)

Returns the [text track cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) from the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) that are currently active (i.e. that start before the [current playback position](#173.html_current-playback-position) and end after it), as a [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object.

`textTrack` . [`addCue`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-addcue)( `cue` )

Adds the given cue to `textTrack`'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues).

`textTrack` . [`removeCue`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-removecue)( `cue` )

Removes the given cue from `textTrack`'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues).

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-media-addtexttrack" data-anolis-xref="dom-media-addTextTrack">`addTextTrack(``kind``,` `label``,` `language``)`</dfn> method of [media elements](#173.html_media-element), when invoked, must run the following steps:

1.  Create a new [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object.

2.  Create a new [text track](#173.html_text-track) corresponding to the new object, and set its [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) to `kind`, its [text track label](#173.html_text-track-label) to `label`, its [text track language](#173.html_text-track-language) to `language`, its [text track readiness state](#173.html_text-track-readiness-state) to the [text track loaded](#173.html_text-track-loaded) state, its [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) to the [text track hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) mode, and its [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) to an empty list.

    Initially, the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) is not associated with any [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering). When a [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) is added to it, the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) has its rules permanently set accordingly.

3.  Add the new [text track](#173.html_text-track) to the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks).

4.  [Queue a task](#173.html_queue-a-task) to [fire](#173.html_concept-event-fire) a [trusted](#173.html_concept-events-trusted) event with the name [`addtrack`](#173.html_event-media-addtrack), that does not bubble and is not cancelable, and that uses the [`TrackEvent`](#173.html_trackevent) interface, with the [`track`](#173.html_dom-trackevent-track) attribute initialized to the new [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object, at the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [`textTracks`](#173.html_dom-media-texttracks) attribute's [`TextTrackList`](#173.html_texttracklist) object.

5.  Return the new [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object.

* * *

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-kind" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-kind">`kind`</dfn> attribute must return the [text track kind](#173.html_text-track-kind) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-label" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-label">`label`</dfn> attribute must return the [text track label](#173.html_text-track-label) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-language" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-language">`language`</dfn> attribute must return the [text track language](#173.html_text-track-language) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-id" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-id">`id`</dfn> attribute returns the track's identifier, if it has one, or the empty string otherwise. For tracks that correspond to [`track`](#173.html_the-track-element) elements, the track's identifier is the value of the element's [`id`](#173.html_the-id-attribute) attribute, if any. For in-band tracks, the track's identifier is specified by the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource). If the [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) is in a format that supports the Media Fragments URI fragment identifier syntax, the identifier returned for a particular track must be the same identifier that would enable the track if used as the name of a track in the track dimension of such a fragment identifier. [[MEDIAFRAG]](#173.html_refsMEDIAFRAG)

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-inbandmetadatatrackdispatchtype" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-inBandMetadataTrackDispatchType">`inBandMetadataTrackDispatchType`</dfn> attribute must return the [text track in-band metadata track dispatch type](#173.html_text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-mode" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-mode">`mode`</dfn> attribute, on getting, must return the string corresponding to the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents, as defined by the following list:

"<dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-disabled" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-disabled">`disabled`</dfn>"

The [text track disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled) mode.

"<dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-hidden" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-hidden">`hidden`</dfn>"

The [text track hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) mode.

"<dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-showing" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-showing">`showing`</dfn>"

The [text track showing](#173.html_text-track-showing) mode.

On setting, if the new value isn't equal to what the attribute would currently return, the new value must be processed as follows:

If the new value is "[`disabled`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-disabled)"

Set the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents to the [text track disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled) mode.

If the new value is "[`hidden`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-hidden)"

Set the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents to the [text track hidden](#173.html_text-track-hidden) mode.

If the new value is "[`showing`](#173.html_dom-texttrack-showing)"

Set the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents to the [text track showing](#173.html_text-track-showing) mode.

If the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents is not the [text track disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled) mode, then the <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-cues" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-cues">`cues`</dfn> attribute must return a [live](#173.html_live) [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object that represents the subset of the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents whose [end times](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) occur at or after the [earliest possible position when the script started](#173.html_earliest-possible-position-when-the-script-started), in [text track cue order](#173.html_text-track-cue-order). Otherwise, it must return null. When an object is returned, the same object must be returned each time.

The <dfn id="173.html_earliest-possible-position-when-the-script-started">earliest possible position when the script started</dfn> is whatever the [earliest possible position](#173.html_earliest-possible-position) was the last time the [event loop](#173.html_event-loop) reached step 1.

If the [text track mode](#173.html_text-track-mode) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents is not the [text track disabled](#173.html_text-track-disabled) mode, then the <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-activecues" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-activeCues">`activeCues`</dfn> attribute must return a [live](#173.html_live) [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object that represents the subset of the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) that the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object represents whose [active flag was set when the script started](#173.html_active-flag-was-set-when-the-script-started), in [text track cue order](#173.html_text-track-cue-order). Otherwise, it must return null. When an object is returned, the same object must be returned each time.

A [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue)'s <dfn id="173.html_active-flag-was-set-when-the-script-started">active flag was set when the script started</dfn> if its [text track cue active flag](#173.html_text-track-cue-active-flag) was set the last time the [event loop](#173.html_event-loop) reached step 1.

* * *

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-addcue" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-addCue">`addCue(``cue``)`</dfn> method of [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) objects, when invoked, must run the following steps:

1.  If the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) does not yet have any associated [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering), then associate the [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) with the [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) appropriate to `cue`.

2.  If [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues)' associated [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) are not the same [rules for updating the text track rendering](#173.html_rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) as appropriate for `cue`, then throw an [`InvalidStateError`](#173.html_invalidstateerror) exception and abort these steps.

3.  If the given `cue` is in a [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues), then remove `cue` from that [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues).

4.  Add `cue` to the method's [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object's [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues).

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrack-removecue" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrack-removeCue">`removeCue(``cue``)`</dfn> method of [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) objects, when invoked, must run the following steps:

1.  If the given `cue` is not currently listed in the method's [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object's [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues), then throw a [`NotFoundError`](#173.html_notfounderror) exception and abort these steps.

2.  Remove `cue` from the method's [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object's [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [text track list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues).

In this example, an [`audio`](#173.html_the-audio-element) element is used to play a specific sound-effect from a sound file containing many sound effects. A cue is used to pause the audio, so that it ends exactly at the end of the clip, even if the browser is busy running some script. If the page had relied on script to pause the audio, then the start of the next clip might be heard if the browser was not able to run the script at the exact time specified.

```
var sfx = new Audio('sfx.wav');
var sounds = sfx.addTextTrack('metadata');

// add sounds we care about
function addFX(start, end, name) {
  var cue = new VTTCue(start, end, '');
  cue.id = name;
  cue.pauseOnExit = true;
  sounds.addCue(cue);
}
addFX(12.783, 13.612, 'dog bark');
addFX(13.612, 15.091, 'kitten mew'))

function playSound(id) {
  sfx.currentTime = sounds.getCueById(id).startTime;
  sfx.play();
}

// play a bark as soon as we can
sfx.oncanplaythrough = function () {
  playSound('dog bark');
}
// meow when the user tries to leave
window.onbeforeunload = function () {
  playSound('kitten mew');
  return 'Are you sure you want to leave this awesome page?';
}
```

* * *

```
interface TextTrackCueList {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter TextTrackCue (unsigned long index);
  TextTrackCue? getCueById(DOMString id);
};
```

`cuelist` . [`length`](#173.html_dom-texttrackcuelist-length)

Returns the number of [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) in the list.

`cuelist`[`index`]

Returns the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) with index `index` in the list. The cues are sorted in [text track cue order](#173.html_text-track-cue-order).

`cuelist` . [`getCueById`](#173.html_dom-texttrackcuelist-getcuebyid)( `id` )

Returns the first [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) (in [text track cue order](#173.html_text-track-cue-order)) with [text track cue identifier](#173.html_text-track-cue-identifier) `id`.

Returns null if none of the cues have the given identifier or if the argument is the empty string.

A [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object represents a dynamically updating list of [text track cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) in a given order.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcuelist-length" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCueList-length">`length`</dfn> attribute must return the number of [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object.

The [supported property indices](#173.html_supported-property-indices) of a [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object at any instant are the numbers from zero to the number of [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object minus one, if any. If there are no [cues](#173.html_text-track-cue) in the list, there are no [supported property indices](#173.html_supported-property-indices).

To [determine the value of an indexed property](#173.html_determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property) for a given index `index`, the user agent must return the `index`th [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcuelist-getcuebyid" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCueList-getCueById">`getCueById(``id``)`</dfn> method, when called with an argument other than the empty string, must return the first [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) in the list represented by the [`TextTrackCueList`](#173.html_texttrackcuelist) object whose [text track cue identifier](#173.html_text-track-cue-identifier) is `id`, if any, or null otherwise. If the argument is the empty string, then the method must return null.

* * *

```
interface TextTrackCue : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute TextTrack? track;

           attribute DOMString id;
           attribute double startTime;
           attribute double endTime;
           attribute boolean pauseOnExit;

           attribute EventHandler onenter;
           attribute EventHandler onexit;
};
```

`cue` . [track](#173.html_dom-texttrackcue-track)

Returns the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object to which this [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) belongs, if any, or null otherwise.

`cue` . [id](#173.html_dom-texttrackcue-id) [ = `value` ]

Returns the [text track cue identifier](#173.html_text-track-cue-identifier).

Can be set.

`cue` . [startTime](#173.html_dom-texttrackcue-starttime) [ = `value` ]

Returns the [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time), in seconds.

Can be set.

`cue` . [endTime](#173.html_dom-texttrackcue-endtime) [ = `value` ]

Returns the [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time), in seconds.

Can be set.

`cue` . [pauseOnExit](#173.html_dom-texttrackcue-pauseonexit) [ = `value` ]

Returns true if the [text track cue pause-on-exit flag](#173.html_text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag) is set, false otherwise.

Can be set.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcue-track" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCue-track">`track`</dfn> attribute, on getting, must return the [`TextTrack`](#173.html_texttrack) object of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) in whose [list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) that the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object represents finds itself, if any; or null otherwise.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcue-id" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCue-id">`id`</dfn> attribute, on getting, must return the [text track cue identifier](#173.html_text-track-cue-identifier) of the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) that the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object represents. On setting, the [text track cue identifier](#173.html_text-track-cue-identifier) must be set to the new value.

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcue-starttime" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCue-startTime">`startTime`</dfn> attribute, on getting, must return the [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time) of the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) that the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object represents, in seconds. On setting, the [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time) must be set to the new value, interpreted in seconds; then, if the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object's [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) is in a [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues), and that [text track](#173.html_text-track) is in a [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks), and the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [show poster flag](#173.html_show-poster-flag) is not set, then run the *[time marches on](#173.html_time-marches-on)* steps for that [media element](#173.html_media-element).

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcue-endtime" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCue-endTime">`endTime`</dfn> attribute, on getting, must return the [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) of the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) that the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object represents, in seconds. On setting, the [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) must be set to the new value, interpreted in seconds; then, if the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object's [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) is in a [text track](#173.html_text-track)'s [list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues), and that [text track](#173.html_text-track) is in a [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [list of text tracks](#173.html_list-of-text-tracks), and the [media element](#173.html_media-element)'s [show poster flag](#173.html_show-poster-flag) is not set, then run the *[time marches on](#173.html_time-marches-on)* steps for that [media element](#173.html_media-element).

The <dfn id="173.html_dom-texttrackcue-pauseonexit" data-anolis-xref="dom-TextTrackCue-pauseOnExit">`pauseOnExit`</dfn> attribute, on getting, must return true if the [text track cue pause-on-exit flag](#173.html_text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag) of the [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) that the [`TextTrackCue`](#173.html_texttrackcue) object represents is set; or false otherwise. On setting, the [text track cue pause-on-exit flag](#173.html_text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag) must be set if the new value is true, and must be unset otherwise.

###### 4.7.10.12.6 Text tracks describing chapters

Chapters are segments of a [media resource](#173.html_media-resource) with a given title. Chapters can be nested, in the same way that sections in a document outline can have subsections.

Each [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) in a [text track](#173.html_text-track) being used for describing chapters has three key features: the [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time), giving the start time of the chapter, the [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time), giving the end time of the chapter, and the [text track cue data](#173.html_text-track-cue-data) giving the chapter title.

The <dfn id="173.html_rules-for-constructing-the-chapter-tree-from-a-text-track">rules for constructing the chapter tree from a text track</dfn> are as follows. They produce a potentially nested list of chapters, each of which have a start time, end time, title, and a list of nested chapters. This algorithm discards cues that do not correctly nest within each other, or that are out of order.

1.  Let `list` be a copy of the [list of cues](#173.html_text-track-list-of-cues) of the [text track](#173.html_text-track) being processed.

2.  Remove from `list` any [text track cue](#173.html_text-track-cue) whose [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) is before its [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time).

3.  Let `output` be an empty list of chapters, where a chapter is a record consisting of a start time, an end time, a title, and a (potentially empty) list of nested chapters. For the purpose of this algorithm, each chapter also has a parent chapter.

4.  Let `current chapter` be a stand-in chapter whose start time is negative infinity, whose end time is positive infinity, and whose list of nested chapters is `output`. (This is just used to make the algorithm easier to describe.)

5.  *Loop*: If `list` is empty, jump to the step labeled *end*.

6.  Let `current cue` be the first cue in `list`, and then remove it from `list`.

7.  If `current cue`'s [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time) is less than the start time of `current chapter`, then return to the step labeled *loop*.

8.  While `current cue`'s [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time) is greater than or equal to `current chapter`'s end time, let `current chapter` be `current chapter`'s parent chapter.

9.  If `current cue`'s [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time) is greater than the end time of `current chapter`, then return to the step labeled *loop*.

10.  Create a new chapter `new chapter`, whose start time is `current cue`'s [text track cue start time](#173.html_text-track-cue-start-time), whose end time is `current cue`'s [text track cue end time](#173.html_text-track-cue-end-time), whose title is `current cue`'s [text track cue data](#173.html_text-track-cue-data) interpreted according to its [rules for rendering the cue in isolation](#173.html_rules-for-rendering-the-cue-in-isolation), and whose list of nested chapters is empty.

    For WebVTT, the [rules for rendering the cue in isolation](#173.html_rules-for-rendering-the-cue-in-isolation) are the [rules for interpreting WebVTT cue text](#173.html_rules-for-interpreting-webvtt-cue-text). [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

11.  Append `new chapter` to `current chapter`'s list of nested chapters, and let `current chapter` be `new chapter`'s parent.

12.  Let `current chapter` be `new chapter`.

13.  Return to the step labeled *loop*.

14.  *End*: Return `output`.

The following snippet of a [WebVTT file](#173.html_webvtt-file) shows how nested chapters can be marked up. The file describes three 50-minute chapters, "Astrophysics", "Computational Physics", and "General Relativity". The first has three subchapters, the second has four, and the third has two. [[WEBVTT]](#173.html_refsWEBVTT)

```
WEBVTT

00:00:00.000 --> 00:50:00.000
Astrophysics

00:00:00.000 --> 00:10:00.000
Introduction to Astrophysics

00:10:00.000 --> 00:45:00.000
The Solar System

00:00:00.000 --> 00:10:00.000
Coursework Description

00:50:00.000 --> 01:40:00.000
Computational Physics

00:50:00.000 --> 00:55:00.000
Introduction to Programming

00:55:00.000 --> 01:30:00.000
Data Structures

01:30:00.000 --> 01:35:00.000
Answers to Last Exam

01:35:00.000 --> 01:40:00.000
Coursework Description

01:40:00.000 --> 02:30:00.000
General Relativity

01:40:00.000 --> 02:00:00.000
Tensor Algebra

02:00:00.000 --> 02:30:00.000
The General Relativistic Field Equations
```
