*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 3.2S Draft//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.0 Frameset//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.0 Transitional//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML Experimental 19960712//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML Experimental 970421//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD W3 HTML//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3O//DTD W3 HTML 3.0//`"
*   The public identifier is set to: "`-//W3O//DTD W3 HTML Strict 3.0//EN//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//WebTechs//DTD Mozilla HTML 2.0//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//WebTechs//DTD Mozilla HTML//`"
*   The public identifier is set to: "`-/W3C/DTD HTML 4.0 Transitional/EN`"
*   The public identifier is set to: "`HTML`"
*   The system identifier is set to: "`http://www.ibm.com/data/dtd/v11/ibmxhtml1-transitional.dtd`"
*   The system identifier is missing and the public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01 Frameset//`"
*   The system identifier is missing and the public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01 Transitional//`"

Otherwise, if the document is *not* [an `iframe` `srcdoc` document](#338.html_an-iframe-srcdoc-document), and the DOCTYPE token matches one of the conditions in the following list, then set the [`Document`](#338.html_document) to [limited-quirks mode](#338.html_limited-quirks-mode):

*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Frameset//`"
*   The public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//`"
*   The system identifier is not missing and the public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01 Frameset//`"
*   The system identifier is not missing and the public identifier starts with: "`-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01 Transitional//`"

The system identifier and public identifier strings must be compared to the values given in the lists above in an [ASCII case-insensitive](#338.html_ascii-case-insensitive) manner. A system identifier whose value is the empty string is not considered missing for the purposes of the conditions above.

Then, switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[before html](#338.html_the-before-html-insertion-mode)".

Anything else

If the document is *not* [an `iframe` `srcdoc` document](#338.html_an-iframe-srcdoc-document), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); set the [`Document`](#338.html_document) to [quirks mode](#338.html_quirks-mode).

In any case, switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[before html](#338.html_the-before-html-insertion-mode)", then reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.2 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-before-html" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: before html">before html</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[before html](#338.html_the-before-html-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment) as the last child of the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object.

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

[Create an element for the token](#338.html_create-an-element-for-the-token) in the [HTML namespace](#338.html_html-namespace-0), with the [`Document`](#338.html_document) as the intended parent. Append it to the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object. Put this element in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

If the [`Document`](#338.html_document) is being loaded as part of [navigation](#338.html_navigate) of a [browsing context](#338.html_browsing-context), then: if the newly created element has a [`manifest`](#338.html_attr-html-manifest) attribute whose value is not the empty string, then [resolve](#338.html_resolve-a-url) the value of that attribute to an [absolute URL](#338.html_absolute-url), relative to the newly created element, and if that is successful, run the [application cache selection algorithm](#338.html_concept-appcache-init) with the result of applying the [URL serializer](#338.html_concept-url-serializer) algorithm to the resulting [parsed URL](#338.html_parsed-url) with the *exclude fragment flag* set; otherwise, if there is no such attribute, or its value is the empty string, or resolving its value fails, run the [application cache selection algorithm](#338.html_concept-appcache-init) with no manifest. The algorithm must be passed the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[before head](#338.html_the-before-head-insertion-mode)".

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "head", "body", "html", "br"

Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

Any other end tag

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Create an [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element whose [`ownerDocument`](#338.html_dom-node-ownerdocument) is the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object. Append it to the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object. Put this element in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

If the [`Document`](#338.html_document) is being loaded as part of [navigation](#338.html_navigate) of a [browsing context](#338.html_browsing-context), then: run the [application cache selection algorithm](#338.html_concept-appcache-init) with no manifest, passing it the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[before head](#338.html_the-before-head-insertion-mode)", then reprocess the token.

The root element can end up being removed from the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object, e.g. by scripts; nothing in particular happens in such cases, content continues being appended to the nodes as described in the next section.

###### 8.2.5.4.3 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-before-head" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: before head">before head</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[before head](#338.html_the-before-head-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the token.

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "head"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Set the [`head` element pointer](#338.html_head-element-pointer) to the newly created [`head`](#338.html_the-head-element) element.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)".

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "head", "body", "html", "br"

Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

Any other end tag

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "head" start tag token with no attributes.

Set the [`head` element pointer](#338.html_head-element-pointer) to the newly created [`head`](#338.html_the-head-element) element.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)".

Reprocess the current token.

###### 8.2.5.4.4 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-head" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in head">in head</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

[Insert the character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag), if it is set.

A start tag whose tag name is "meta"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag), if it is set.

If the element has a [`charset`](#338.html_attr-meta-charset) attribute, and [getting an encoding](#338.html_getting-an-encoding) from its value results in a supported [ASCII-compatible character encoding](#338.html_ascii-compatible-character-encoding) or [a UTF-16 encoding](#338.html_a-utf-16-encoding), and the [confidence](#338.html_concept-encoding-confidence) is currently *tentative*, then [change the encoding](#338.html_change-the-encoding) to the resulting encoding.

Otherwise, if the element has an [`http-equiv`](#338.html_attr-meta-http-equiv) attribute whose value is an [ASCII case-insensitive](#338.html_ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string "`Content-Type`", and the element has a [`content`](#338.html_attr-meta-content) attribute, and applying the [algorithm for extracting a character encoding from a `meta` element](#338.html_algorithm-for-extracting-a-character-encoding-from-a-meta-element) to that attribute's value returns a supported [ASCII-compatible character encoding](#338.html_ascii-compatible-character-encoding) or [a UTF-16 encoding](#338.html_a-utf-16-encoding), and the [confidence](#338.html_concept-encoding-confidence) is currently *tentative*, then [change the encoding](#338.html_change-the-encoding) to the extracted encoding.

A start tag whose tag name is "title"

Follow the [generic RCDATA element parsing algorithm](#338.html_generic-rcdata-element-parsing-algorithm).

A start tag whose tag name is "noscript", if the [scripting flag](#338.html_scripting-flag) is enabled
A start tag whose tag name is one of: "noframes", "style"

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#338.html_generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm).

A start tag whose tag name is "noscript", if the [scripting flag](#338.html_scripting-flag) is disabled

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in head noscript](#338.html_parsing-main-inheadnoscript)".

A start tag whose tag name is "script"

Run these steps:

1.  Let the `adjusted insertion location` be the [appropriate place for inserting a node](#338.html_appropriate-place-for-inserting-a-node).

2.  [Create an element for the token](#338.html_create-an-element-for-the-token) in the [HTML namespace](#338.html_html-namespace-0), with the intended parent being the element in which the `adjusted insertion location` finds itself.

3.  Mark the element as being ["parser-inserted"](#338.html_parser-inserted) and unset the element's ["force-async"](#338.html_force-async) flag.

    This ensures that, if the script is external, any [`document.write()`](#338.html_dom-document-write) calls in the script will execute in-line, instead of blowing the document away, as would happen in most other cases. It also prevents the script from executing until the end tag is seen.

4.  If the parser was originally created for the [HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#338.html_html-fragment-parsing-algorithm), then mark the [`script`](#338.html_the-script-element) element as ["already started"](#338.html_already-started). ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

5.  Insert the newly created element at the `adjusted insertion location`.

6.  Push the element onto the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) so that it is the new [current node](#338.html_current-node).

7.  Switch the tokenizer to the [script data state](#338.html_script-data-state).

8.  Let the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode) be the current [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

9.  Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[text](#338.html_parsing-main-incdata)".

An end tag whose tag name is "head"

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be the [`head`](#338.html_the-head-element) element) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after head](#338.html_the-after-head-insertion-mode)".

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "html", "br"

Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

A start tag whose tag name is "template"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Insert a marker at the end of the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements).

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in template](#338.html_parsing-main-intemplate)".

Push "[in template](#338.html_parsing-main-intemplate)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is "template"

If there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:

1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element has been popped from the stack.

4.  [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#338.html_clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker).
5.  Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

6.  [Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

A start tag whose tag name is "head"
Any other end tag

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be the [`head`](#338.html_the-head-element) element) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after head](#338.html_the-after-head-insertion-mode)".

Reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.5 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-head-noscript" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in head noscript">in head noscript</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in head noscript](#338.html_parsing-main-inheadnoscript)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is "noscript"

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be a [`noscript`](#338.html_the-noscript-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements); the new [current node](#338.html_current-node) will be a [`head`](#338.html_the-head-element) element.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)".

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE
A comment token
A start tag whose tag name is one of: "basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "style"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is "br"

Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "head", "noscript"
Any other end tag

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be a [`noscript`](#338.html_the-noscript-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements); the new [current node](#338.html_current-node) will be a [`head`](#338.html_the-head-element) element.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)".

Reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.6 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-after-head" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: after head">after head</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[after head](#338.html_the-after-head-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

[Insert the character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "body"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)".

A start tag whose tag name is "frameset"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in frameset](#338.html_parsing-main-inframeset)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "script", "style", "template", "title"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Push the node pointed to by the [`head` element pointer](#338.html_head-element-pointer) onto the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Remove the node pointed to by the [`head` element pointer](#338.html_head-element-pointer) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). (It might not be the [current node](#338.html_current-node) at this point.)

The [`head` element pointer](#338.html_head-element-pointer) cannot be null at this point.

An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "html", "br"

Act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

A start tag whose tag name is "head"
Any other end tag

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "body" start tag token with no attributes.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)".

Reprocess the current token.

###### 8.2.5.4.7 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-body" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in body">in body</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is U+0000 NULL

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert the token's character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

Any other character token

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert the token's character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If there is a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then ignore the token.

Otherwise, for each attribute on the token, check to see if the attribute is already present on the top element of the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). If it is not, add the attribute and its corresponding value to that element.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "script", "style", "template", "title"
An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "body"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the second element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`body`](#338.html_the-body-element) element, if the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) has only one node on it, or if there is a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise, set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok"; then, for each attribute on the token, check to see if the attribute is already present on the [`body`](#338.html_the-body-element) element (the second element) on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), and if it is not, add the attribute and its corresponding value to that element.

A start tag whose tag name is "frameset"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) has only one node on it, or if the second element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`body`](#338.html_the-body-element) element, then ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

If the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) is set to "not ok", ignore the token.

Otherwise, run the following steps:

1.  Remove the second element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) from its parent node, if it has one.

2.  Pop all the nodes from the bottom of the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), from the [current node](#338.html_current-node) up to, but not including, the root [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element.

3.  [Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

4.  Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in frameset](#338.html_parsing-main-inframeset)".

An end-of-file token

If there is a node in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) element, a [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) element, an [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) element, a [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element, a [`tbody`](#338.html_the-tbody-element) element, a [`td`](#338.html_the-td-element) element, a [`tfoot`](#338.html_the-tfoot-element) element, a [`th`](#338.html_the-th-element) element, a [`thead`](#338.html_the-thead-element) element, a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element, the [`body`](#338.html_the-body-element) element, or the [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) is not empty, then process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in template](#338.html_parsing-main-intemplate)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Otherwise, [stop parsing](#338.html_stop-parsing).

An end tag whose tag name is "body"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `body` element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, if there is a node in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) element, a [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) element, an [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) element, an [`optgroup`](#338.html_the-optgroup-element) element, an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, a [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element, an [`rb`](#338.html_the-rb-element) element, an [`rp`](#338.html_the-rp-element) element, an [`rt`](#338.html_the-rt-element) element, an [`rtc`](#338.html_the-rtc-element) element, a [`tbody`](#338.html_the-tbody-element) element, a [`td`](#338.html_the-td-element) element, a [`tfoot`](#338.html_the-tfoot-element) element, a [`th`](#338.html_the-th-element) element, a [`thead`](#338.html_the-thead-element) element, a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element, the [`body`](#338.html_the-body-element) element, or the [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after body](#338.html_parsing-main-afterbody)".

An end tag whose tag name is "html"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `body` element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, if there is a node in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) element, a [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) element, an [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) element, an [`optgroup`](#338.html_the-optgroup-element) element, an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, a [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element, an [`rb`](#338.html_the-rb-element) element, an [`rp`](#338.html_the-rp-element) element, an [`rt`](#338.html_the-rt-element) element, an [`rtc`](#338.html_the-rtc-element) element, a [`tbody`](#338.html_the-tbody-element) element, a [`td`](#338.html_the-td-element) element, a [`tfoot`](#338.html_the-tfoot-element) element, a [`th`](#338.html_the-th-element) element, a [`thead`](#338.html_the-thead-element) element, a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element, the [`body`](#338.html_the-body-element) element, or the [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after body](#338.html_parsing-main-afterbody)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "address", "article", "aside", "blockquote", "center", "details", "dialog", "dir", "div", "dl", "fieldset", "figcaption", "figure", "footer", "header", "hgroup", "main", "nav", "ol", "p", "section", "summary", "ul"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) whose tag name is one of "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", or "h6", then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "pre", "listing"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

If the [next token](#338.html_next-token) is a "LF" (U+000A) character token, then ignore that token and move on to the next one. (Newlines at the start of [`pre`](#338.html_the-pre-element) blocks are ignored as an authoring convenience.)

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

A start tag whose tag name is "form"

If the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) is not null, and there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, and, if there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), set the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) to point to the element created.

A start tag whose tag name is "li"

Run these steps:

1.  Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

2.  Initialize `node` to be the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (the bottommost node of the stack).

3.  *Loop*: If `node` is an [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) element, then run these substeps:

    1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags), except for [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) elements.

    2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not an [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

    3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until an [`li`](#338.html_the-li-element) element has been popped from the stack.

    4.  Jump to the step labeled *done* below.

4.  If `node` is in the [special](#338.html_special) category, but is not an [`address`](#338.html_the-address-element), [`div`](#338.html_the-div-element), or [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element, then jump to the step labeled *done* below.

5.  Otherwise, set `node` to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) and return to the step labeled *loop*.

6.  *Done*: If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

7.  Finally, [insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "dd", "dt"

Run these steps:

1.  Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

2.  Initialize `node` to be the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (the bottommost node of the stack).

3.  *Loop*: If `node` is a [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) element, then run these substeps:

    1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags), except for [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) elements.

    2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

    3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`dd`](#338.html_the-dd-element) element has been popped from the stack.

    4.  Jump to the step labeled *done* below.

4.  If `node` is a [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) element, then run these substeps:

    1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags), except for [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) elements.

    2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

    3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`dt`](#338.html_the-dt-element) element has been popped from the stack.

    4.  Jump to the step labeled *done* below.

5.  If `node` is in the [special](#338.html_special) category, but is not an [`address`](#338.html_the-address-element), [`div`](#338.html_the-div-element), or [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element, then jump to the step labeled *done* below.

6.  Otherwise, set `node` to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) and return to the step labeled *loop*.

7.  *Done*: If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

8.  Finally, [insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "plaintext"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Switch the tokenizer to the [PLAINTEXT state](#338.html_plaintext-state).

Once a start tag with the tag name "plaintext" has been seen, that will be the last token ever seen other than character tokens (and the end-of-file token), because there is no way to switch out of the [PLAINTEXT state](#338.html_plaintext-state).

A start tag whose tag name is "button"

1.  If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `button` element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), then run these substeps:

    1.  [Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

    2.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

    3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`button`](#338.html_the-button-element) element has been popped from the stack.

2.  [Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

3.  [Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

4.  Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "address", "article", "aside", "blockquote", "button", "center", "details", "dialog", "dir", "div", "dl", "fieldset", "figcaption", "figure", "footer", "header", "hgroup", "listing", "main", "nav", "ol", "pre", "section", "summary", "ul"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:

1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack.

An end tag whose tag name is "form"

If there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then run these substeps:

1.  Let `node` be the element that the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) is set to, or null if it is not set to an element.

2.  Set the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) to null. Otherwise, let `node` be null.

3.  If `node` is null or if the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have `node` in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); abort these steps and ignore the token.

4.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

5.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not `node`, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

6.  Remove `node` from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

If there *is* a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then run these substeps instead:

1.  If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `form` element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); abort these steps and ignore the token.

2.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

3.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`form`](#338.html_the-form-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

4.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`form`](#338.html_the-form-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

An end tag whose tag name is "li"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an `li` element in list item scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-list-item-scope), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:

2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and whose tag name is one of "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", or "h6", then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "sarcasm"

Take a deep breath, then act as described in the "any other end tag" entry below.

A start tag whose tag name is "a"

If the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements) contains an [`a`](#338.html_the-a-element) element between the end of the list and the last marker on the list (or the start of the list if there is no marker on the list), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); run the [adoption agency algorithm](#338.html_adoption-agency-algorithm) for the tag name "a", then remove that element from the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements) and the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) if the [adoption agency algorithm](#338.html_adoption-agency-algorithm) didn't already remove it (it might not have if the element is not [in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope)).

In the non-conforming stream `<a href="a">a<table><a href="b">b</table>x`, the first [`a`](#338.html_the-a-element) element would be closed upon seeing the second one, and the "x" character would be inside a link to "b", not to "a". This is despite the fact that the outer [`a`](#338.html_the-a-element) element is not in table scope (meaning that a regular `</a>` end tag at the start of the table wouldn't close the outer [`a`](#338.html_the-a-element) element). The result is that the two [`a`](#338.html_the-a-element) elements are indirectly nested inside each other — non-conforming markup will often result in non-conforming DOMs when parsed.

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token. [Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#338.html_push-onto-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "b", "big", "code", "em", "font", "i", "s", "small", "strike", "strong", "tt", "u"

A start tag whose tag name is "nobr"

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

An end tag token whose tag name is one of: "applet", "marquee", "object"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "form" start tag token with no attributes, and, if there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), set the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) to point to the element created.

If the token has an attribute called "action", set the [`action`](#338.html_attr-fs-action) attribute on the resulting [`form`](#338.html_the-form-element) element to the value of the "action" attribute of the token.

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for an "hr" start tag token with no attributes. Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "label" start tag token with no attributes.

[Insert characters](#338.html_insert-a-character) (see below for [what they should say](#338.html_attr-isindex-prompt)).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for an "input" start tag token with all the attributes from the "isindex" token except "name", "action", and "prompt", and with an attribute named "name" with the value "isindex". (This creates an [`input`](#338.html_the-input-element) element with the [`name`](#338.html_attr-fe-name) attribute set to the magic balue "[`isindex`](#338.html_attr-fe-name-isindex)".) Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Insert more characters](#338.html_insert-a-character) (see below for [what they should say](#338.html_attr-isindex-prompt)).

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be the [`label`](#338.html_the-label-element) element created earlier) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for an "hr" start tag token with no attributes. Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be the [`form`](#338.html_the-form-element) element created earlier) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), and, if there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), set the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) back to null.

<dfn id="338.html_attr-isindex-prompt" data-anolis-xref="attr-isindex-prompt">**Prompt**</dfn>: If the token has an attribute with the name "prompt", then the first stream of characters must be the same string as given in that attribute, and the second stream of characters must be empty. Otherwise, the two streams of character tokens together should, together with the [`input`](#338.html_the-input-element) element, express the equivalent of "This is a searchable index. Enter search keywords: (input field)" in the user's preferred language.

A start tag whose tag name is "textarea"

Run these steps:

1.  [Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

2.  If the [next token](#338.html_next-token) is a "LF" (U+000A) character token, then ignore that token and move on to the next one. (Newlines at the start of [`textarea`](#338.html_the-textarea-element) elements are ignored as an authoring convenience.)

3.  Switch the tokenizer to the [RCDATA state](#338.html_rcdata-state).

4.  Let the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode) be the current [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

5.  Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

6.  Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[text](#338.html_parsing-main-incdata)".

A start tag whose tag name is "xmp"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-button-scope), then [close a `p` element](#338.html_close-a-p-element).

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#338.html_generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm).

A start tag whose tag name is "iframe"

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#338.html_generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm).

A start tag whose tag name is "noembed"
A start tag whose tag name is "noscript", if the [scripting flag](#338.html_scripting-flag) is enabled

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#338.html_generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm).

A start tag whose tag name is "select"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#338.html_frameset-ok-flag) to "not ok".

If the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) is one of "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)", "[in caption](#338.html_parsing-main-incaption)", "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)", "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)", or "[in cell](#338.html_parsing-main-intd)", then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in select in table](#338.html_parsing-main-inselectintable)". Otherwise, switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in select](#338.html_parsing-main-inselect)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "optgroup", "option"

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, then pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "rb", "rp", "rtc"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `ruby` element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), then [generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags). If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not then a [`ruby`](#338.html_the-ruby-element) element, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "rt"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) [has a `ruby` element in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), then [generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags), except for [`rtc`](#338.html_the-rtc-element) elements. If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not then a [`ruby`](#338.html_the-ruby-element) element or an [`rtc`](#338.html_the-rtc-element) element, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "math"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Adjust MathML attributes](#338.html_adjust-mathml-attributes) for the token. (This fixes the case of MathML attributes that are not all lowercase.)

[Adjust foreign attributes](#338.html_adjust-foreign-attributes) for the token. (This fixes the use of namespaced attributes, in particular XLink.)

[Insert a foreign element](#338.html_insert-a-foreign-element) for the token, in the [MathML namespace](#338.html_mathml-namespace).

If the token has its *self-closing flag* set, pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) and [acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag).

A start tag whose tag name is "svg"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Adjust SVG attributes](#338.html_adjust-svg-attributes) for the token. (This fixes the case of SVG attributes that are not all lowercase.)

[Adjust foreign attributes](#338.html_adjust-foreign-attributes) for the token. (This fixes the use of namespaced attributes, in particular XLink in SVG.)

[Insert a foreign element](#338.html_insert-a-foreign-element) for the token, in the [SVG namespace](#338.html_svg-namespace).

If the token has its *self-closing flag* set, pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) and [acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "frame", "head", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Any other start tag

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#338.html_reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

This element will be an [ordinary](#338.html_ordinary) element.

Any other end tag

Run these steps:

1.  Initialize `node` to be the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (the bottommost node of the stack).

2.  *Loop*: If `node` is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as the token, then:

    1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags), except for [HTML elements](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as the token.

    2.  If `node` is not the [current node](#338.html_current-node), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

    3.  Pop all the nodes from the [current node](#338.html_current-node) up to `node`, including `node`, then stop these steps.

3.  Otherwise, if `node` is in the [special](#338.html_special) category, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token, and abort these steps.

4.  Set `node` to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

5.  Return to the step labeled *loop*.

When the steps above say the user agent is to <dfn id="338.html_close-a-p-element">close a `p` element</dfn>, it means that the user agent must run the following steps:

1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags), except for [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) elements.

2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`p`](#338.html_the-p-element) element has been popped from the stack.

The <dfn id="338.html_adoption-agency-algorithm">adoption agency algorithm</dfn>, which takes as its only argument a tag name `subject` for which the algorithm is being run, consists of the following steps:

1.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) whose tag name is `subject`, then run these substeps:

    1.  Let `element` be the [current node](#338.html_current-node).

    2.  Pop `element` off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

    3.  If `element` is also in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements), remove the element from the list.

    4.  Abort the [adoption agency algorithm](#338.html_adoption-agency-algorithm).

2.  Let `outer loop counter` be zero.

3.  *Outer loop*: If `outer loop counter` is greater than or equal to eight, then abort these steps.

4.  Increment `outer loop counter` by one.

5.  Let `formatting element` be the last element in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements) that:

    *   is between the end of the list and the last scope marker in the list, if any, or the start of the list otherwise, and
    *   has the tag name `subject`.

    If there is no such element, then abort these steps and instead act as described in the "any other end tag" entry above.

6.  If `formatting element` is not in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); remove the element from the list, and abort these steps.

7.  If `formatting element` is in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), but the element is not [in scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-scope), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); abort these steps.

8.  If `formatting element` is not the [current node](#338.html_current-node), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error). (But do not abort these steps.)

9.  Let `furthest block` be the topmost node in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) that is lower in the stack than `formatting element`, and is an element in the [special](#338.html_special) category. There might not be one.

10.  If there is no `furthest block`, then the UA must first pop all the nodes from the bottom of the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), from the [current node](#338.html_current-node) up to and including `formatting element`, then remove `formatting element` from the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements), and finally abort these steps.

11.  Let `common ancestor` be the element immediately above `formatting element` in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

12.  Let a bookmark note the position of `formatting element` in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements) relative to the elements on either side of it in the list.

13.  Let `node` and `last node` be `furthest block`. Follow these steps:

    1.  Let `inner loop counter` be zero.

    2.  *Inner loop*: Increment `inner loop counter` by one.

    3.  Let `node` be the element immediately above `node` in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), or if `node` is no longer in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) (e.g. because it got removed by this algorithm), the element that was immediately above `node` in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) before `node` was removed.

    4.  If `node` is `formatting element`, then go to the next step in the overall algorithm.

    5.  If `inner loop counter` is greater than three and `node` is in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements), then remove `node` from the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements).

    6.  If `node` is not in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements), then remove `node` from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) and then go back to the step labeled *inner loop*.

    7.  [Create an element for the token](#338.html_create-an-element-for-the-token) for which the element `node` was created, in the [HTML namespace](#338.html_html-namespace-0), with `common ancestor` as the intended parent; replace the entry for `node` in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements) with an entry for the new element, replace the entry for `node` in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) with an entry for the new element, and let `node` be the new element.

    8.  If `last node` is `furthest block`, then move the aforementioned bookmark to be immediately after the new `node` in the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements).

    9.  Insert `last node` into `node`, first removing it from its previous parent node if any.

    10.  Let `last node` be `node`.

    11.  Return to the step labeled *inner loop*.

14.  Insert whatever `last node` ended up being in the previous step at the [appropriate place for inserting a node](#338.html_appropriate-place-for-inserting-a-node), but using `common ancestor` as the *override target*.

15.  [Create an element for the token](#338.html_create-an-element-for-the-token) for which `formatting element` was created, in the [HTML namespace](#338.html_html-namespace-0), with `furthest block` as the intended parent.

16.  Take all of the child nodes of `furthest block` and append them to the element created in the last step.

17.  Append that new element to `furthest block`.

18.  Remove `formatting element` from the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements), and insert the new element into the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements) at the position of the aforementioned bookmark.

19.  Remove `formatting element` from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), and insert the new element into the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) immediately below the position of `furthest block` in that stack.

20.  Jump back to the step labeled *outer loop*.

This algorithm's name, the "adoption agency algorithm", comes from the way it causes elements to change parents, and is in contrast with other possible algorithms for dealing with misnested content, which included the "incest algorithm", the "secret affair algorithm", and the "Heisenberg algorithm".

###### 8.2.5.4.8 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-text" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: text">text</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[text](#338.html_parsing-main-incdata)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token

[Insert the token's character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

This can never be a U+0000 NULL character; the tokenizer converts those to U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER characters.

An end-of-file token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is a [`script`](#338.html_the-script-element) element, mark the [`script`](#338.html_the-script-element) element as ["already started"](#338.html_already-started).

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode) and reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "script"

[Perform a microtask checkpoint](#338.html_perform-a-microtask-checkpoint).

[Provide a stable state](#338.html_provide-a-stable-state).

Let `script` be the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be a [`script`](#338.html_the-script-element) element).

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode).

Let the `old insertion point` have the same value as the current [insertion point](#338.html_insertion-point). Let the [insertion point](#338.html_insertion-point) be just before the [next input character](#338.html_next-input-character).

Increment the parser's [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) by one.

[Prepare](#338.html_prepare-a-script) the `script`. This might cause some script to execute, which might cause [new characters to be inserted into the tokenizer](#338.html_dom-document-write), and might cause the tokenizer to output more tokens, resulting in a [reentrant invocation of the parser](#338.html_nestedParsing).

Decrement the parser's [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) by one. If the parser's [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) is zero, then set the [parser pause flag](#338.html_parser-pause-flag) to false.

Let the [insertion point](#338.html_insertion-point) have the value of the `old insertion point`. (In other words, restore the [insertion point](#338.html_insertion-point) to its previous value. This value might be the "undefined" value.)

At this stage, if there is a [pending parsing-blocking script](#338.html_pending-parsing-blocking-script), then:

If the [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) is not zero:

Set the [parser pause flag](#338.html_parser-pause-flag) to true, and abort the processing of any nested invocations of the tokenizer, yielding control back to the caller. (Tokenization will resume when the caller returns to the "outer" tree construction stage.)

The tree construction stage of this particular parser is [being called reentrantly](#338.html_nestedParsing), say from a call to [`document.write()`](#338.html_dom-document-write).

Otherwise:

Run these steps:

1.  Let `the script` be the [pending parsing-blocking script](#338.html_pending-parsing-blocking-script). There is no longer a [pending parsing-blocking script](#338.html_pending-parsing-blocking-script).

2.  Block the [tokenizer](#338.html_tokenization) for this instance of the [HTML parser](#338.html_html-parser), such that the [event loop](#338.html_event-loop) will not run [tasks](#338.html_concept-task) that invoke the [tokenizer](#338.html_tokenization).

3.  If the parser's [`Document`](#338.html_document) [has a style sheet that is blocking scripts](#338.html_has-a-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts) or `the script`'s ["ready to be parser-executed"](#338.html_ready-to-be-parser-executed) flag is not set: [spin the event loop](#338.html_spin-the-event-loop) until the parser's [`Document`](#338.html_document) [has no style sheet that is blocking scripts](#338.html_has-no-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts) and `the script`'s ["ready to be parser-executed"](#338.html_ready-to-be-parser-executed) flag is set.

4.  If this [parser has been aborted](#338.html_abort-a-parser) in the meantime, abort these steps.

    This could happen if, e.g., while the [spin the event loop](#338.html_spin-the-event-loop) algorithm is running, the [browsing context](#338.html_browsing-context) gets closed, or the [`document.open()`](#338.html_dom-document-open) method gets invoked on the [`Document`](#338.html_document).

5.  Unblock the [tokenizer](#338.html_tokenization) for this instance of the [HTML parser](#338.html_html-parser), such that [tasks](#338.html_concept-task) that invoke the [tokenizer](#338.html_tokenization) can again be run.

6.  Let the [insertion point](#338.html_insertion-point) be just before the [next input character](#338.html_next-input-character).

7.  Increment the parser's [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) by one (it should be zero before this step, so this sets it to one).

8.  [Execute](#338.html_execute-the-script-block) `the script`.

9.  Decrement the parser's [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) by one. If the parser's [script nesting level](#338.html_script-nesting-level) is zero (which it always should be at this point), then set the [parser pause flag](#338.html_parser-pause-flag) to false.

10.  Let the [insertion point](#338.html_insertion-point) be undefined again.

11.  If there is once again a [pending parsing-blocking script](#338.html_pending-parsing-blocking-script), then repeat these steps from step 1.

Any other end tag

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode).

###### 8.2.5.4.9 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-table" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in table">in table</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token, if the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is [`table`](#338.html_the-table-element), [`tbody`](#338.html_the-tbody-element), [`tfoot`](#338.html_the-tfoot-element), [`thead`](#338.html_the-thead-element), or [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element

Let the <dfn id="338.html_pending-table-character-tokens">`pending table character tokens`</dfn> be an empty list of tokens.

Let the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode) be the current [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table text](#338.html_parsing-main-intabletext)" and reprocess the token.

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "caption"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context). (See below.)

Insert a marker at the end of the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in caption](#338.html_parsing-main-incaption)".

A start tag whose tag name is "colgroup"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in column group](#338.html_parsing-main-incolgroup)".

A start tag whose tag name is "col"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "colgroup" start tag token with no attributes, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in column group](#338.html_parsing-main-incolgroup)".

Reprocess the current token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "td", "th", "tr"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "tbody" start tag token with no attributes, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)".

Reprocess the current token.

A start tag whose tag name is "table"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `table` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), ignore the token.

Otherwise:

Pop elements from this stack until a [`table`](#338.html_the-table-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `table` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

Pop elements from this stack until a [`table`](#338.html_the-table-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "style", "script", "template"
An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "input"

If the token does not have an attribute with the name "type", or if it does, but that attribute's value is not an [ASCII case-insensitive](#338.html_ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string "`hidden`", then: act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

Otherwise:

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

Pop that [`input`](#338.html_the-input-element) element off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag), if it is set.

A start tag whose tag name is "form"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If there is a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), or if the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) is not null, ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, and set the [`form` element pointer](#338.html_form-element-pointer) to point to the element created.

Pop that [`form`](#338.html_the-form-element) element off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

An end-of-file token

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Enable [foster parenting](#338.html_foster-parent), process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), and then disable [foster parenting](#338.html_foster-parent).

When the steps above require the UA to <dfn id="338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context">clear the stack back to a table context</dfn>, it means that the UA must, while the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`table`](#338.html_the-table-element), [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element), or [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

The [current node](#338.html_current-node) being an [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element after this process is a [fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case).

###### 8.2.5.4.10 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-table-text" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in table text">in table text</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in table text](#338.html_parsing-main-intabletext)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is U+0000 NULL

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Any other character token

Append the character token to the [`pending table character tokens`](#338.html_pending-table-character-tokens) list.

Anything else

If any of the tokens in the [`pending table character tokens`](#338.html_pending-table-character-tokens) list are character tokens that are not [space characters](#338.html_space-character), then reprocess the character tokens in the [`pending table character tokens`](#338.html_pending-table-character-tokens) list using the rules given in the "anything else" entry in the "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)" insertion mode.

Otherwise, [insert the characters](#338.html_insert-a-character) given by the [`pending table character tokens`](#338.html_pending-table-character-tokens) list.

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#338.html_original-insertion-mode) and reprocess the token.
