When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in caption](#338.html_parsing-main-incaption)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

An end tag whose tag name is "caption"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `caption` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise:

[Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

Now, if the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`caption`](#338.html_the-caption-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Pop elements from this stack until a [`caption`](#338.html_the-caption-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#338.html_clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"
An end tag whose tag name is "table"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `caption` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise:

Pop elements from this stack until a [`caption`](#338.html_the-caption-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#338.html_clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)".

Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "col", "colgroup", "html", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

###### 8.2.5.4.12 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-column-group" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in column group">in column group</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in column group](#338.html_parsing-main-incolgroup)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

[Insert the character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "col"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag), if it is set.

An end tag whose tag name is "colgroup"

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`colgroup`](#338.html_the-colgroup-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)".

An end tag whose tag name is "col"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "template"
An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end-of-file token

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Anything else

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`colgroup`](#338.html_the-colgroup-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)".

Reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.13 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-table-body" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in table body">in table body</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A start tag whose tag name is "tr"

[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "th", "td"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for a "tr" start tag token with no attributes, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)".

Reprocess the current token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as the token, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context). (See below.)

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"
An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tbody`, `thead`, or `tfoot` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context). (See below.)

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)".

Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html", "td", "th", "tr"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

When the steps above require the UA to <dfn id="338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context">clear the stack back to a table body context</dfn>, it means that the UA must, while the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`tbody`](#338.html_the-tbody-element), [`tfoot`](#338.html_the-tfoot-element), [`thead`](#338.html_the-thead-element), [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element), or [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

The [current node](#338.html_current-node) being an [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element after this process is a [fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case).

###### 8.2.5.4.14 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-row" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in row">in row</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "th", "td"

[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in cell](#338.html_parsing-main-intd)".

Insert a marker at the end of the [list of active formatting elements](#338.html_list-of-active-formatting-elements).

An end tag whose tag name is "tr"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tr` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context). (See below.)

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead", "tr"
An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tr` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context). (See below.)

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)".

Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as the token, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tr` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context). (See below.)

Pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) (which will be a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)".

Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html", "td", "th"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

When the steps above require the UA to <dfn id="338.html_clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context">clear the stack back to a table row context</dfn>, it means that the UA must, while the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not a [`tr`](#338.html_the-tr-element), [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element), or [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

The [current node](#338.html_current-node) being an [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element after this process is a [fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case).

###### 8.2.5.4.15 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-cell" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in cell">in cell</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in cell](#338.html_parsing-main-intd)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "td", "th"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise:

[Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

Now, if the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) stack until an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack.

[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#338.html_clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does *not* [have a `td` or `th` element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope), then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise, [close the cell](#338.html_close-the-cell) (see below) and reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "table", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead", "tr"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

Otherwise, [close the cell](#338.html_close-the-cell) (see below) and reprocess the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Where the steps above say to <dfn id="338.html_close-the-cell">close the cell</dfn>, they mean to run the following algorithm:

1.  [Generate implied end tags](#338.html_generate-implied-end-tags).

2.  If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not now a [`td`](#338.html_the-td-element) element or a [`th`](#338.html_the-th-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

3.  Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) stack until a [`td`](#338.html_the-td-element) element or a [`th`](#338.html_the-th-element) element has been popped from the stack.

4.  [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#338.html_clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker).

5.  Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)".

The [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) cannot have both a [`td`](#338.html_the-td-element) and a [`th`](#338.html_the-th-element) element [in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope) at the same time, nor can it have neither when the [close the cell](#338.html_close-the-cell) algorithm is invoked.

###### 8.2.5.4.16 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-select" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in select">in select</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in select](#338.html_parsing-main-inselect)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is U+0000 NULL

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

Any other character token

[Insert the token's character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "option"

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, pop that node from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "optgroup"

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, pop that node from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`optgroup`](#338.html_the-optgroup-element) element, pop that node from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "optgroup"

First, if the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, and the node immediately before it in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) is an [`optgroup`](#338.html_the-optgroup-element) element, then pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`optgroup`](#338.html_the-optgroup-element) element, then pop that node from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Otherwise, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "option"

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is an [`option`](#338.html_the-option-element) element, then pop that node from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements). Otherwise, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "select"

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `select` element in select scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-select-scope), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise:

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#338.html_the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

A start tag whose tag name is "select"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#338.html_the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

It just gets treated like an end tag.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "input", "keygen", "textarea"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `select` element in select scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-select-scope), ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#338.html_the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

Reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "script", "template"
An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end-of-file token

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.17 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-select-in-table" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in select in table">in select in table</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in select in table](#338.html_parsing-main-inselectintable)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "table", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead", "tr", "td", "th"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#338.html_the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "table", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead", "tr", "td", "th"

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

If the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#338.html_has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an [HTML element](#338.html_html-elements) and with the same tag name as that of the token, then ignore the token.

Otherwise:

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#338.html_the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

Reprocess the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in select](#338.html_parsing-main-inselect)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

###### 8.2.5.4.18 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-template" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in template">in template</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in template](#338.html_parsing-main-intemplate)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token
A comment token
A DOCTYPE token

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "script", "style", "template", "title"
An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "colgroup", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

Push "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table](#338.html_parsing-main-intable)", and reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "col"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

Push "[in column group](#338.html_parsing-main-incolgroup)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in column group](#338.html_parsing-main-incolgroup)", and reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "tr"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

Push "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#338.html_parsing-main-intbody)", and reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "td", "th"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

Push "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in row](#338.html_parsing-main-intr)", and reprocess the token.

Any other start tag

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

Push "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)", and reprocess the token.

Any other end tag

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

An end-of-file token

If there is no [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements), then [stop parsing](#338.html_stop-parsing). ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise, this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) until a [`template`](#338.html_the-template-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#338.html_clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker).

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#338.html_current-template-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#338.html_stack-of-template-insertion-modes).

[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#338.html_reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately).

Reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.19 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-after-body" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: after body">after body</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[after body](#338.html_parsing-main-afterbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment) as the last child of the first element in the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements) (the [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is "html"

If the parser was originally created as part of the [HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#338.html_html-fragment-parsing-algorithm), this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise, switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after after body](#338.html_the-after-after-body-insertion-mode)".

An end-of-file token

[Stop parsing](#338.html_stop-parsing).

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" and reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.20 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-in-frameset" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: in frameset">in frameset</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in frameset](#338.html_parsing-main-inframeset)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

[Insert the character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "frameset"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "frameset"

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is the root [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case))

Otherwise, pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) from the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

If the parser was *not* originally created as part of the [HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#338.html_html-fragment-parsing-algorithm) ([fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case)), and the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is no longer a [`frameset`](#338.html_frameset) element, then switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after frameset](#338.html_parsing-main-afterframeset)".

A start tag whose tag name is "frame"

[Insert an HTML element](#338.html_insert-an-html-element) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#338.html_current-node) off the [stack of open elements](#338.html_stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#338.html_acknowledge-self-closing-flag), if it is set.

A start tag whose tag name is "noframes"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end-of-file token

If the [current node](#338.html_current-node) is not the root [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#338.html_parse-error).

The [current node](#338.html_current-node) can only be the root [`html`](#338.html_the-html-element) element in the [fragment case](#338.html_fragment-case).

[Stop parsing](#338.html_stop-parsing).

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.21 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-after-frameset" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: after frameset">after frameset</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[after frameset](#338.html_parsing-main-afterframeset)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE

[Insert the character](#338.html_insert-a-character).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is "html"

Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[after after frameset](#338.html_the-after-after-frameset-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is "noframes"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in head](#338.html_parsing-main-inhead)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end-of-file token

[Stop parsing](#338.html_stop-parsing).

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Ignore the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.22 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-after-after-body" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: after after body">after after body</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[after after body](#338.html_the-after-after-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment) as the last child of the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object.

A DOCTYPE token
A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE
A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).

An end-of-file token

[Stop parsing](#338.html_stop-parsing).

Anything else

[Parse error](#338.html_parse-error). Switch the [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode) to "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" and reprocess the token.

###### 8.2.5.4.23 The "<dfn id="338.html_insertion-mode:-after-after-frameset" data-anolis-xref="insertion mode: after after frameset">after after frameset</dfn>" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[after after frameset](#338.html_the-after-after-frameset-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#338.html_insert-a-comment) as the last child of the [`Document`](#338.html_document) object.

A DOCTYPE token
A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, "LF" (U+000A), "FF" (U+000C), "CR" (U+000D), or U+0020 SPACE
A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#338.html_using-the-rules-for) the "[in body](#338.html_parsing-main-inbody)" [insertion mode](#338.html_insertion-mode).
